policy_notes: M1a allows GET requests from dedicated HubSpot developer test account and local PostgreSQL inserts only; it does not allow HubSpot CRM writes.
All fields are protected from writes in M0 even if in a future allowlist.
Email and associations are reviewed but never automatically repaired in V1.
Allowlist does not imply safety: every proposed patch needs an approved change plan, a fresh preflight read and post-write verification.
Company legal identity and domain conflicts require review, not automatic normalization.
Merging is excluded from automated workflows, including synthetic demos.
